title: Part Time IT Support
description:
Company Name : New York Life
Job Type : Part Time
Language : Japanese & English
Office Location : Tokyo
Job Type : Remote ( All though Initial 1 Week needs to visit office to understand the process )

Candidates must be from Japan to apply for this role.

This is a flexible, part-time role requiring 5-10 hours per week. We understand this might be a great fit for someone seeking a second job. The role will involve a monthly allocation of hours that can be billed on a Time & Materials (T&M) basis.
Ideally, we are looking for someone who is fluent in Japanese (native-level proficiency) with strong English communication skills. If you have experience in helpdesk/network support and are looking for a manageable workload, we'd love to discuss the position with you in more detail.
In Japan, similar roles typically offer between ¥300,000 to ¥500,000 per month (approx. $2,100 to $3,500 USD), depending on experience and location.
If this sounds like something you would be interested in, I'd love to connect and explore further!
